archetypes.name: Heretic
archetypes.desc:
- A Legendary Retinue may additionally include models from the following armies: Chaos Daemons, Chaos Space Marines, Genestealer Cults.
- It may no longer include models from the following armies: Adeptus Sororitas, Space Marines.

archetypes.name: Iconoclast
archetypes.desc:
- A Legendary Retinue may additionally include models from the following armies: Dark Eldar, Eldar, Leagues of Votann, Orks, T'au Empire.
- It may no longer include models from the following armies: Adeptus Sororitas, Space Marines.
